desc:
AI product help for online stores gives shoppers instant answers from your catalog, and gives your team drafted product descriptions and support replies to approve. Ecom Swift LLC sets it up in your Shopify, WooCommerce or BigCommerce account and tests it with real shopper questions.

## What is AI product help for an online store?

It is a set of tools that use your own product data and policies to answer questions and draft text. A shopping assistant sits on your store pages and replies to questions such as whether a jacket runs small or when an order will arrive. Behind the scenes, other tools draft product descriptions and support replies that your team edits before anything is published.

The important part is the source. The assistant reads your catalog, shipping rules and returns policy, so it answers from your facts instead of general knowledge.

## Why shoppers leave without answers

A visitor with a question has two options: ask and wait, or leave. Most leave. Questions about sizing, compatibility, delivery dates and returns come up on nearly every product page, and each one that goes unanswered is a shopper who may buy elsewhere.

Your team faces the other side of the same problem. The same ten questions arrive by email every day, and product descriptions for new items pile up in a to-do list.

## How it affects sales and workload

An assistant that answers at the moment of doubt removes a reason to abandon the page. It can also point shoppers to related products from your catalog, in the way a good shop assistant would. Drafted descriptions get new products live sooner, and drafted support replies shorten the time customers wait.

Results depend on the quality of your product data and on how well the answers match what shoppers ask. Thin descriptions produce thin answers, so we flag gaps in your catalog during testing.

## What a good store set-up includes

- A chat assistant placed on product, collection and cart pages and styled to match your theme.
- Product data read from your catalog, including variants and key attributes.
- Answers on shipping, returns and sizing taken from your own policy pages.
- Order status lookup, where your platform supports it.
- Product suggestions that only show items you actually stock.
- Description drafts in your tone, held in a review screen before they go live.
- Support replies drafted from your policies, with a handoff to your support email.
- Rules about what the assistant must not discuss or promise.
- Usage limits and a cost report, so spend stays visible.
- A test round using real questions from your shoppers.

## What we do

We work inside your store account on Shopify, WooCommerce or BigCommerce. We read your catalog and policy pages, set up the assistant, test it with real questions and adjust until the answers are accurate and on brand.

The Basic package adds the shopping assistant over part of your catalog. The Standard package covers a larger catalog, drafted descriptions for approval, size and fit answers and order status lookup. The Premium package adds support replies, a handoff to your inbox, suggestions in chat, usage limits and a cost report. We never overwrite existing product text without your approval.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Clean up product titles, variants and sizing charts before connecting them.
- Write your shipping and returns policy in plain words.
- Review every drafted description before it goes live.
- Set a monthly usage limit.
- Keep a clear route to a real person.

**Avoid:**
- Letting the assistant quote prices or stock that are not in your data.
- Publishing drafted text in bulk with no review.
- Hiding the fact that shoppers are chatting with an assistant.
- Training it on private supplier or cost information.
- Launching without testing it on your slowest, most confusing products.

## Who it is for

A store with a growing catalog and a small team receives the same sizing and delivery questions every day. A brand that adds new products each month needs first drafts of descriptions in its own voice. A shop owner wants to offer help outside business hours without hiring.

## What we need from you

We need access to your store as a collaborator or staff user, with permission to edit theme code and read products, and a short note on your tone and policies. AI usage is billed by the provider in your own account, and we help you set up limits. We never ask for your password, and everything is shown to you for approval before it goes live.
